verdict.rationale: Increase has a dedicated webhooks page in which it says it will 'reach out to your application' so you can act automatically. It also offers a List Events API as a polling alternative, and sends special real-time webhooks for card authorization decisions. A first-party customer story says Ramp ingests webhooks for each step of the ACH transfer lifecycle. Missing for 10: details on configuring subscriptions and filtering event types, signature verification and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
